title.zh: v12 P-XXL 战满 400 回合，29:28 险胜老牌霸主 Player5
title.en: v12 P-XXL edges Player5 29-28 in a 400-turn 57-capture duel

desc.zh: 全场 400 回合爆发 57 次夺旗互拆，分差始终维持在 1 分以内。P-XXL 凭借关键截杀在最后时刻稳住防线拿下胜利。
desc.en: A relentless 57-capture shootout where the margin never exceeded one. P-XXL secured the decisive stop in the final moments.
